description: The height of a TmSegmentedControl tray. Sm and Md mirror the input heights so the tray lines up with the fields next to it; Lg is the roomiest control. On a coarse pointer every size grows to the 44 px touch target.

members.name: Sm
members.description: Compact: 32 px, the small input height. Wants the small font size.

members.name: Md
members.description: Default: 38 px, the medium input height.

members.name: Lg
members.description: Roomy: 44 px, the large input height — the same block size a finger needs.
